artifact.name: draw.war
artifact.reproducibility_note: The distributed member is the release WAR's viewer build, not the 4,935,096-byte blob committed in the fixed public tree. The release build has no public build log or manifest; Lyrel does not claim the published viewer-static.min.js is reproducible from the public tree. The embedded shape and stencil bundles account for part of the difference; this is recorded, not asserted byte-for-byte.

excluded_from_distribution.js/extensions.min.js: Not distributed. Contains LGPL-2.1-or-later libavoid (wasm2js, no public corresponding source/binding/build) and EPL-2.0 ELK port (no public exact source). Its obligations cannot be closed from the fixed artifact, so the viewer does not include it.
excluded_from_distribution.math4/ and MathJax: Not distributed; math=0 and the native handler refuses the paths.
Not distributed; font license not established.
excluded_from_distribution.img/: Not distributed; the viewer bundle embeds only the shape/stencil data it needs.
